scripts.dev: zsh -lc 'source "$HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh" && nvm use 23 >/dev/null && concurrently "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"'
scripts.dev:frontend: zsh -lc 'source "$HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh" && nvm use 23 >/dev/null && npm --prefix frontend run dev'
scripts.dev:backend: zsh -lc 'source "$HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh" && nvm use 23 >/dev/null && npm --prefix backend run dev'
scripts.build: zsh -lc 'source "$HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh" && nvm use 23 >/dev/null && npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix backend run build'
